import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix extends ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> {
        public Matrix(int rows, int cols) {
            super();
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                ArrayList<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    row.add(0);
                }
                this.add(row);
            }
        }

        public static Matrix identity(int size) {
            Matrix id = new Matrix(size, size);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                id.get(i).set(i, 1);
            }
            return id;
        }

        public Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            int n = this.size();
            int k = this.get(0).size();
            int m = other.get(0).size();
            Matrix result = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int l = 0; l < k; l++) {
                        sum += (long) this.get(i).get(l) * other.get(l).get(j);
                    }
                    result.get(i).set(j, (int) (sum % MOD));
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static Matrix rotateShift(Matrix matrixIn, int shiftAmount) {
        int size = matrixIn.size() - 1;
        shiftAmount = (size - shiftAmount) % size;
        Matrix result = new Matrix(matrixIn.size(), matrixIn.get(0).size());
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                int rowIdx = (i + shiftAmount) % size;
                int colIdx = (j + shiftAmount) % size;
                result.get(i).set(j, matrixIn.get(rowIdx).get(colIdx));
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
            int colIdx = (j + shiftAmount) % size;
            result.get(size).set(j, matrixIn.get(size).get(colIdx));
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        int maxDepth = 0;
        long temp = n;
        while (temp != 0) {
            maxDepth++;
            temp /= k;
        }

        List<Matrix> dpMatrices = new ArrayList<>();
        // Initialize dp_matrices[0]
        Matrix base0 = new Matrix(k + 1, k + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                if (i == j || j == 0) {
                    base0.get(i).set(j, 1);
                } else {
                    base0.get(i).set(j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        dpMatrices.add(base0);

        // Build other matrices
        Matrix identity = Matrix.identity(k + 1);
        for (int depth = 1; depth < maxDepth; depth++) {
            Matrix prev = dpMatrices.get(depth - 1);
            Matrix current = identity;
            int current_x = k;
            int i = 0;
            while ((1 << i) <= current_x) {
                if ((current_x & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    current = prev.multiply(rotateShift(dpMatrices.get(depth - 1), 1 << i));
                    current_x ^= (1 << i);
                }
                prev = prev.multiply(rotateShift(prev, 1 << i));
                i++;
            }
            dpMatrices.add(current);
        }

        // Initialize base vector
        Matrix initialBase = new Matrix(1, k + 1);
        initialBase.get(0).set(k, 1);

        int shiftIndex = 0;
        long x_value = n;
        List<Integer> baseDigits = new ArrayList<>();
        while (x_value != 0) {
            baseDigits.add((int) (x_value % k));
            x_value /= k;
        }

        int totalLength = baseDigits.size();
        for (int idx = totalLength - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
            int remainder = baseDigits.get(idx);
            for (int it = 0; it < remainder; it++, shiftIndex = (shiftIndex + 1) % k) {
                initialBase = initialBase.multiply(rotateShift(dpMatrices.get(idx), shiftIndex));
            }
        }

        int totalRes = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            totalRes = (totalRes + initialBase.get(0).get(i)) % (int)MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(totalRes);
        sc.close();
    }
}
